title: Field Engineer
description:
Field Network Engineer 
 Job Title Field Network Engineer Trainee
 Department Technical / Network Operations
 Employment Type Full-Time
 Job Locations All 30 Districts of Odisha
 Experience Freshers / Experience
 Qualification B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma / MCA / MBA (IT)
 Passing Year 2023 & Above Pass-outs
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for enthusiastic and technically inclined Field Network Engineer Trainees to join our Network Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team. The selected candidates will be responsible for field-level network support, fault management, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and restoration of network services across assigned locations.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Perform network fault identification, troubleshooting, maintenance, and technical support as part of O&M activities. Visit customer/project sites for network installation, inspection, troubleshooting, and maintenance. Monitor and resolve network connectivity and equipment-related issues. Perform basic troubleshooting of LAN/WAN, routers, switches, modems, optical fiber, and network connectivity. Escalate complex technical issues to senior engineers and follow up until resolution. Carry out preventive maintenance and routine health checks of network infrastructure. Maintain proper records of faults, site visits, equipment status, and resolution details. Coordinate with customers, field teams, service providers, and senior technical personnel. Ensure timely closure of assigned complaints/tickets within defined timelines. Follow company/project SOPs, safety guidelines, and reporting procedures. Be willing to travel within the assigned district and nearby project locations. 
 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 Laptop Mandatory. Two-wheeler/Bike Mandatory. Valid Driving Licence is preferred/required for field movement. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Willingness to work in field locations and travel within the assigned district. Basic knowledge of networking concepts and troubleshooting. Candidates should be comfortable working in an O&M / field support environment. 
 Candidate Profile 
 Strong interest in Networking and IT Infrastructure. Good problem-solving and troubleshooting ability. Willing to work in rural/semi-urban and field locations. Ability to work independently as well as in a team. Good discipline, punctuality, and willingness to learn. Candidates who are willing to build a career in Network Operations & Maintenance are encouraged to apply. What We Offer 
 On-the-job technical training and practical exposure. Opportunity to work on large-scale network infrastructure projects. Career growth in Network Engineering, O&M and IT Infrastructure. Exposure to real-time network troubleshooting and field operations.
